experiment_data.hypothesis: 解码策略鲁棒性: Pythia-1.4B 在 temperature-only τ=0.9 下递归生成的深度信号与 nucleus p=0.95 一致，支持跨策略泛化

spec.command: bash scripts/run_pipeline_pythia_temp09.sh (Pythia-1.4B, 3x LoRA finetune + 3x generate, temp_only τ=0.9)

experiment_data.notes:
## Comparison: temp_only τ=0.9 vs baseline nucleus p=0.95

### 4-class classification (d0-d3)
| Metric | Baseline (nucleus p=0.95) | Temp09 (τ=0.9) | Δ |
|--------|--------------------------|-----------------|---|
| RF acc | 78.15% [76.9, 79.4] | 76.25% [74.9, 77.5] | -1.9pp |
| LR acc | 74.92% | 74.05% | -0.9pp |
| AUC 0v1 | 0.9975 | 0.9968 | -0.0007 |
| AUC 1v2 | 0.8607 | 0.8327 | -0.028 |
| AUC 2v3 | 0.8005 | 0.7928 | -0.008 |

### 3-class classification (d1-d3 only)
| Metric | Baseline | Temp09 | Δ |
|--------|----------|--------|---|
| Full acc | 70.8% | 69.83% | -1.0pp |
| Filtered acc | — | 72.52% [70.6, 74.3] | — |
| Filtered d1v2 AUC | — | 0.8656 | — |
| Filtered d2v3 AUC | — | 0.8295 | — |

### Feature importance (top-5, same ranking)
1. var_surprisal (0.178 vs 0.169)
2. p90_ppl (0.150 vs 0.158)
3. mean_ppl (0.114 vs 0.120)
4. mean_surprisal (0.089 vs 0.088)
5. p75_ppl (0.069 vs 0.067)

### Code contamination
| Depth | Baseline | Temp09 | Δ |
|-------|----------|--------|---|
| d1 | 5.0% | 7.7% | +2.7pp |
| d2 | 9.0% | 11.6% | +2.6pp |
| d3 | 12.0% | 13.6% | +1.6pp |

### Analysis
1. **Depth signal robust across decoding strategies**: temp_only τ=0.9 achieves 76.25% 4-class acc (vs 78.15% baseline), only 1.9pp lower — well within the hypothesis that depth signal is decoding-strategy-agnostic.
2. **Ordinal structure preserved**: AUC ordering 0v1 > 1v3 > 1v2 > 2v3 identical to baseline, confirming the difficulty gradient d0≫d1>d2>d3 is robust.
3. **d2 remains the weak link**: d2 recall (0.554 in 3-class) is the lowest, consistent with baseline — d2 is the hardest to distinguish from both d1 and d3.
4. **Feature importance stable**: Top-5 features identical between strategies with near-identical importance weights, suggesting the same statistical signatures carry depth information regardless of decoding method.
5. **Higher code contamination**: Temp09 shows 2-3pp higher code-like content across depths, possibly because temperature-only sampling without top-p truncation preserves more of the distribution tail including code patterns. The filtered 3-class acc (72.52%) mitigates this.
6. **Conclusion: SUCCESS** — 4-class acc 76.25% >> 40% threshold, d1v2 AUC 0.8327 >> 0.6 threshold. Hypothesis confirmed: temperature-only decoding preserves recursive depth signal.
